title: Go to the Superhero City workflow to generate an action-movie style scene with…
content:
Go to the Superhero City workflow to generate an action-movie style scene with Seedance.  
Upload your photo as the input to place yourself as the lead character in the generated scene.  
Run the Superhero City workflow using Seedance 2.5 to produce the cinematic action sequence.
